reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Straps are fine, and they're a sensible tool for this. When grip is the weak link on pulls, the back gets to work harder than it otherwise would. Use them on your heavier working sets and try to keep grip work in your training too, since it'll help over time. If you tell me your goal and how many days you train, I can build a program around it."}
